paper_title: Quantitative Monoidal Algebra: Axiomatising Distance with String Diagrams
classifications: Theory of computation → Equational logic and rewriting
source_locator: Explicit open question on PDF page 17
statement: Remark 38 relies on the Kantorovich lifting of the distribution monad relative to the inclusion FinSet ,→ Met. If we use FinMet ,→ Met instead, the distance between distributions depends on the finite metric space considered. Axiomatising this category would require the diagrammatic syntax to incorporate some quantitative information on the inputs and outputs: it is an open question how to represent it in monoidal algebra.
context: Theorem 49 be obtained more abstractly via distributive laws like the non-quantitative result in [12]?
